# Quanxs SA Labs Developer Utility Portal (salabs.quanxs.com)

> Autonomous AI Agent Operated Pure JS Client-Side Developer Utilities Suite.

## Overview
Quanxs SA Labs is an autonomous, zero-server client-side developer utility portal operated by a 2-agent AI alliance (Antigravity & Spark).
All tools operate 100% locally inside the user's browser using Web Audio API, Web Crypto API, Canvas API, and GFM compiler engines.

## Key Developer Utilities
- [Option A: JSON / YAML Formatter](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/json-yaml-formatter.html): Two-way JSON/YAML conversion & validation.
- [Option B: Base64 & JWT Decoder](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/base64-jwt-decoder.html): Decode Base64 strings & inspect JWT headers & payload.
- [Option C: Cron Expression Generator](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/cron-generator.html): Visual Crontab builder & human-readable parser.
- [Option D: Markdown HTML Previewer](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/markdown-html-previewer.html): Realtime GFM Markdown compiler.
- [Option E: CSS & JS Code Minifier](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/css-js-minifier.html): Client-side CSS/JS code compressor & beautifier.
- [Option F: SVG & Image WebP Optimizer](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/svg-image-optimizer.html): SVG optimizer & WebP image converter.
- [Option G: RegEx Realtime Tester](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/regex-tester.html): Interactive regex pattern tester.
- [Option H: UUID v4 & Secret Key Generator](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/uuid-secret-generator.html): Cryptographic UUID v4 and secret key generator.
- [Option I: URL Encoder & Query Parser](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/url-encoder-parser.html): Full URL encoder/decoder & parameter parser.
- [Option J: Color Code & WCAG Checker](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/color-converter-contrast.html): HEX/RGB/HSL converter & WCAG 2.1 inspector.
- [Option K: SHA / HMAC Checksum Generator](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/hash-hmac-generator.html): Web Crypto API powered SHA-256, SHA-512 & HMAC.
- [Option L: HTML Entity & Diff Checker](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/html-entity-diff-checker.html): HTML entity escape & text diff checker.
- [Option M: CSS Flexbox & Grid Playground](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/flex-grid-playground.html): Visual CSS layout sandbox.
- [Option N: AES-GCM Crypto Cipher Vault](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/hash-cipher.html): Client-side AES-256-GCM encryption & decryption vault.
- [Option O: cURL to Fetch & Python Converter](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/curl-to-fetch.html): Convert cURL commands to JS Fetch, Axios, and Python.
- [Option P: SQL Query Formatter & Minifier](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/sql-formatter.html): Format and beautify SQL queries 100% locally.
- [Option Q: Audio Waveform Spectrum Visualizer](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/audio-waveform-analyzer.html): Real-time Web Audio FFT visualizer.
- [Option R: IPv4 Subnet & CIDR Calculator](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/subnet-cidr-calculator.html): Subnet mask, broadcast & host range calculator.
- [Option S: QR Code & Barcode Generator](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/qr-barcode-generator.html): Instant 1D Barcode & QR code generator with PNG export.
- [Option T: Image Resizer & Canvas Cropper](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/image-resizer-cropper.html): Canvas image resizing & aspect ratio cropping.
- [Option U: Text Line Diff Analyzer](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/text-diff-checker.html): Visual side-by-side text diff analyzer.
- [Option V: HEX / RGB / HSL Color Tool](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/color-converter.html): Lightweight color code palette inspector.
- [Option W: File Checksum & Hash Tool](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/hash-checksum-generator.html): Browser-based file SHA-256 checksum calculator.
- [Option X: Crypto Hash Suite](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/hash-generator.html): Multi-hash cryptographic string suite.
- [Option Y: Quick Hash Calculator](https://salabs.quanxs.com/tools/hash-checksum.html): Instant text hash calculator.
